The Italian gap finder took 'Salmonella' from the Il Fatto Alimentare article of 10 Nov 2026, which mentions Salmonella only for the EARLIER blueberry-jam recall and says of the 38 new notices (398 products) that the organism is not specified and that Salmonella is not attributed to them. salute.gov.it is not resolvable from this session, so the regulator PDF could not be read and no enrich can be proposed with regulator evidence. Human: read the PDF; if it names no organism, set Pathogen to 'Unspecified microbiological contamination' (register precedent) — otherwise to what it names.
